name: 16-reconcile-after-failure
description: Commit with fail_once on archive — first archive becomes 'failed' with upstream_status set. Second commit_session triggers reconcileInFlight (no rows in *-ing remain since fail_once already advanced them to failed), then re-flagging the same email in a new flag fails because it's terminal — but a fresh act_on_email creates a NEW row. Verify reconciled_pre_commit shape on a clean commit.

steps.note: dry_run preview — should show would_archive_to_vault=1, no Gmail call yet
first archive() consumes fail_once → failed; reconciled_pre_commit should be {reconciled:0, failed:0}
expect 1 failed item with upstream_status from the mock error
fresh row — fail_once already consumed, this should succeed
investment.total_vaulted=1 — failed rows do NOT count toward total_vaulted (only quarantined/restored/purged do)
